scripts.preaab: npm run bump:patch && npm run bump:android:versionCode
scripts.debug: VITE_FORCE_MEMBER_ON_DEBUG=true npx vite build --mode debug && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd ..
scripts.build: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd ..
scripts.aab: npx vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd ..
scripts.assets:generate: mkdir -p resources && cp src/ui/assets/logo-icon.png resources/icon.png && cp src/ui/assets/logo-icon.png resources/splash.png && npx @capacitor/assets generate resources
